comment: Prof Raymond is really sweet, and very easy to follow in class. She wants all of her students to do well, and is willing to meet with you if you need. There is a lot of homework, but most of it isn't turned in. She goes over stuff a lot of times so if you pay attention in class and do the homework you don't really need to study much for the tests.

She is the best prof out there. She assigns homework, but you dont really have to do it. She is kind and caring and her tests are really fair and she always gives extra credit. Please taker her for ur language requirement. You won't regret it.

I LOVED Dr. Raymond!! I went into UR thinking I was going to take French just for the requirement but her teaching and her compassion led me to take another French course and minor in French! She gives clear expectations about what to expect on tests and grades very fairly. Take French with her if you can!!

Raymond was incredibly kind and understanding. If I ever had a question or needed an extension, she graciously helped me. She was clear in her expectations and her lessons were interesting and enjoyable. There was a fair amount of homework, but it was not hard to do.

I personally loved Hillary Raymond and thought she was an excellent teacher for 221. That being said, I have lots of prior french knowledge and this is a VERY fast paced class. I had lots of friends who definitely struggled a lot in the class, but I do think that is more a reflection of Richmond's language placement system than Raymonds teaching.

The class is time consuming because it meets everyday, but she is very clear about her expectations and explains every very well. She offers a couple points of extra credit per exam and is very clear about what to expect on each exam. Overall class can be a lot of work, but she's a great, fair professor.

French 221 as a class sucks because you have to go every single day and most days were pretty boring. If you already know some of the material or were on the cusp of a 300 class than you will be very bored.

Dr. Raymond is the best professor I have had at UR. She teaches you exactly what you need to know, nothing more and nothing less. This course was easier than my AP French class in high school, and that wasn't very hard. Her review guides are exact mimics of the exams, so all you need to do to study is the review guides, and there are no surprises.

I absolutely loved taking both Fren 221 and Fren 301 with Prof Raymond. She is SO kind and genuinely wants her students to succeed. I went into French 221 just wanting to fulfill my language requirement but Prof Raymond really instilled in me a love for the language.

Madame Raymond is an amazing professor. She cares and understands that different people have various abilities in French and will not hold it against you if you are not the best in class. Very good at explaining often confusing materials. I recommend her 10 times out of 10.

Dr. Raymond is the absolute best professor I've ever had. She's so caring towards her students and is very reasonable and understanding. She also helped me improve my French skills so much. The class is relatively easy and the tests aren't meant to trick you and are very similar to the review sheets. Definitely recommend.

221 is so much work, it lives up to its 'intensive' name, however Prof. Raymond was clear about how she would grade assignments and when they were due. If you are able to keep up with time management and get assignments in on time you will be okay. She is very helpful during office hours if you need extra help. It is a lot of work outside of class.

Dr. Raymond was the perfect 221 professor. She understood that most students were taking it for the gen ed and was a very lenient grader and gave lots of feedback. We could do corrections. 5 tests, final exam, large presentation and lots of extra credit opportunities. As long as you put in effort, speak up in class, and study you will do great!

Professor Raymond is an amazing french professor. This course is demanding in and of itself, so you have to stay on top of your work. However, professor Raymond is very helpful and ensures that the class stays interested in what we are talking about. She allows us to learn a lot of useful vocabulary for talking about the real world as well.
Dr Raymond is a joy to have as a professor. French 221 is a hard class, but she makes it easy and even enjoyable. She is engaging, always friendly, and very caring.

She is super nice and understanding. She will meet with you one on one to explain material. Class is taught in French and there is cold-calling, but it's not horrible. There are 5 chapter tests and 3 points are extra credit are offered on each. Homework is usually out of a workbook (the answers are in the back).
Can't stress enough how great Professor Raymond was this semester, she's so nice and caring. Just wanted to reinforce all the other reviews here.
Very good professor. Kind and straight forward about her expectations. Sweet.

I loved prof Raymond. I really feel like I learned a lot in her class this semester. She truly does care about the success of her students and is easy to reach outside of class if you feel you need help. She gives outlines for each test which are really helpful for studying. Her class isnt the hardest, yet is not the easiest 221 French course.

She is amazing! She makes very clear what will be in our exams and explains concepts very clear, albeit only once or twice. Shes always available for help, though, even right after class. The homework is so tedious, though, and if languages arent your thing, they could take a while to do them right.

Professor Raymond is an excellent French teacher, easy to understand, gives clear directions, I would definitely recommend her. Go to class, participate, and do your homework and you can get a good grade in the class. She makes an effort to make the class interesting, incorporating interesting material. Great teacher.

I adore her! Great professor and person. Gives a reasonable amount of homework, none of it too hard... mostly busywork. Tests are VERY clear and she tells you exactly what you need to know. Very kind and makes you feel very comfortable no matter how good you are. Fantastic class. She is such a sweetheart! Take this class!

She is actually the best language teacher I have ever had. If you are ever at a precipice as to which teacher to choose for your french class, RAYMOND ALL THE WAY. Go to class always. Do the HW always, ( it isnt that much). 4 tests, many quizes so there is always time to improve your grade. THANK YOU DR. RAYMOND.

Excellent! Love her & French!Explains everything clearly, practices regularly in class, and fun! Online homework is daily, but very easy and is graded on completion. Prepares you well for quizzes and tests which are very easy. Go to class regularly so you won't get behind.  NO CLASS ON FRIDAYS :D (so 4 days) Only homework due the following Monday.

Incredible french professor. She is very clear and helpful. Really learn the material. All homework is online and all lab work as well. Only downfall of the class is that we had homework every single night. Still, highly recommend her. Attendance is mandatory

Really great professor.  Took this class just for a gen ed and had a lot of work.  But Dr. Raymond really helps you the French language as my previous French teacher was not very good.  She was always willing to help outside of class.  Sort of a tough grader but more lenient if you show you are putting time and effort into the class.

Dr. Raymond is amazing! I came into French 221 really behind my  peers because I had a horrible French teacher in high school, but I'm now one of the top students in my class because of her help! You can tell she really enjoys teaching, and she is ALWAYS willing to take time out of her day to meet you outside of class. I REALLY recommend taking her

Raymond is a wonderful professor who makes an everyday class completely bearable. She uses a lot of movie clips and songs which are a nice break from regular class work. As long as you come to class and do well on the tests, you should do fine.

Raymond is soo nice, and she always helps you when you do not understand what she is saying. The homework is busy work, but her classes help you learn. If you study a little before each test you'll have no problem.

An excellent professor who I would recommend to anyone. She is, like the others say, very maternal and cares a great deal that the class understands the material. She's a tough grader, or rather, a specific grader (concentrating on all aspects), but she will NEVER insult you. She's much nicer than her syllabus would originally indicate.

Very easygoing professor...was the complete epitome of a "Mom."  She is probably the nicest teacher I've ever had.  Grade-wise she's a little difficult but otherwise very easy.  She's adequate at teaching.  Sometimes not too clear but very helpful
She's a very helpful teacher, and is so nice it's almost scary. She's like an extremely benevolent mother. I feel horrible every time I don't do homework. The class is great.
She is a bit difficult but enjoys teaching and is always available for help. She responds to emails very quickly and wants to see her students do well. Gives tests frequently.
Hard to figure out exactly what she wants. Can be helpful but only if she feels like it and hard to get in touch with because only works part-time.
Dr. Raymond is a great professor--really understanding and clear.  I highly recommend her.
